name: Indian Passport Photo
instructions: Dimensions: 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm (width x height).
Face should cover 70-80% of the photograph area.
Background must be plain white or off-white.

name: PAN Card Application Photo
instructions: Dimensions: 2.5 cm x 3.5 cm.
File size must be strictly under 20KB in JPEG format.
Ensure resolution is 200 DPI scan.

name: PAN Card Signature
instructions: Dimensions: 2 cm x 4.5 cm.
File size must be strictly under 10KB.
Use black ink on plain white paper.

name: Aadhaar Card Document Scan
instructions: Supported formats: PDF, JPEG.
Ensure all text, including the 12-digit UID number, is clearly readable.
Max file size is usually 300KB.

name: United States (US) Visa Photo
instructions: Dimensions: 2 x 2 inches (51 mm x 51 mm) square shape.
Head height must be between 50% and 69% of the total height.
Must be taken on a pure white background, looking straight at the camera.

name: Schengen Visa Photo
instructions: Dimensions: 35 mm x 45 mm.
Close up of head and top of shoulders, covering 70-80% of photo.
Background must be light-coloured, preferably white or light grey.

name: United Kingdom (UK) Visa Photo
instructions: Dimensions: 35 mm width x 45 mm height.
Background must be light grey or cream.
Spectacles must be removed.

name: Canada Visa Photo
instructions: Dimensions: 35 mm width x 45 mm height.
Face height should be between 31 mm and 36 mm.
Must be taken with a neutral expression.

name: Driving License Photo (Sarathi)
instructions: File size: 10KB to 20KB.
Ensure photo matches the physical appearance on application day.

name: Voter ID Photo (NVSP)
instructions: Passport-style photo under 100KB in JPG.
Clear front-facing image.

name: Malaysia E-Visa Photo
instructions: Upload size strictly under 50KB in JPG format.
Studio quality photograph required with a clear white background.

name: Saudi Arabia Visa Photo
instructions: Square aspect ratio (2x2 inches / 200x200 pixels).
Upload size strictly under 100KB in JPG format.

name: Dubai / UAE Tourist Visa Photo
instructions: Dimensions: 300 x 400 pixels.
Upload size strictly under 100KB in JPG.

name: China Visa Photo
instructions: Dimensions: 354 x 472 pixels.
File size must be between 40KB and 120KB in JPG/JPEG.

name: New Zealand Visa Photo
instructions: High resolution photo (between 500KB and 3000KB).
Dimensions: 900 x 1200 pixels.

name: Indian Driving License Photo
instructions: Scanned portrait photo strictly under 20KB for Sarathi portal.

name: Indian Voter ID Photo
instructions: Upload photo strictly under 100KB in JPG format.

name: EWS Income Certificate Scan
instructions: Scan EWS certificate as PDF or JPG strictly under 300KB.

name: Caste / Category Certificate Scan
instructions: Scan certificate as PDF or JPG strictly under 300KB.

name: 10th Class Marksheet / Certificate
instructions: Upload scanned mark sheet strictly under 500KB in PDF or JPG.

name: 12th Class Marksheet / Certificate
instructions: Upload scanned mark sheet strictly under 500KB in PDF or JPG.

name: Resume / CV PDF Document
instructions: Compress your resume to strictly under 500KB in PDF format.
